_comment: Fixed vocabulary for describing what the camera did to color and light. The casting gate requires terms from >=3 categories. All phrased as image qualities - never device names.

white_balance: neutral white balance that misses slightly
exposure: the window behind is blown out
face a half-stop dark against the window
saturation: colors a touch thin in the shadows
skin_cast: mild red patches reading warmer than the rest
slight green cast from overhead fluorescent
neutral skin with warm and cool patches
artifacts: faint noise in the shadow areas
fine detail slightly smeared in low light
mild sharpening halos at high-contrast edges
highlight clipping on the brightest skin
slight softness where focus missed by an inch
